name: Autumn Village Chieftain
source:
Kikyo’s father, the chieftain of the Autumn Village.

He requires Kikyo to accomplish certain tasks before Kikyo can become his heir.

[spoiler]He has been secretly plotting to take over all of Yamato Island, and manipulates Kikyo and Rindoh in order to do so.

He really never planned to let Kikyo succeed him, and instead was going to have him executed for the attack on the Summer Village that he himself ordered Kikyo to do.[/spoiler]
